001: Have you gotten used to the new room yet?
I'm still adjusting, but it's already better than at the beginning.
That's good! What do you think of your roommates?
They're really nice, we even already made plans to cook together this weekend.
That's great! Cooking together really helps build friendships.
For sure. And you, how has your experience been here?
002: Does the noise in the hallway bother you when you're studying?
Sometimes it bothers me a bit, especially at night.
Have you thought about talking to the management?
I have, but I'd rather try to sort it out with the neighbors first.
That makes sense. A friendly conversation can solve a lot.
I hope so. If it doesn't work out, then I'll talk to the management.
003: Have you used the shared laundry room yet?
I used it yesterday for the first time. It's really simple to use.
I need to wash some clothes today, but I'm afraid there won't be a free machine.
Late afternoon usually has fewer people, try that time.
Good tip! I'll leave it for after five.
If you want, I'll let you know when a machine is free.
004: What did you think of the food at the cafeteria today?
Today it was good, but yesterday the rice was a bit dry.
Yeah, the food varies a lot from one day to the next.
That's why I prefer to cook in my room when I have time.
Are you a good cook? What do you know how to make?
I can make a garlic and oil pasta that's a hit here at the housing.
005: Are you liking sharing the room with Rafael?
I am, he's very organized and respects my space.
Lucky you! My roommate leaves his stuff spread out everywhere.
That's annoying. Have you two talked about it?
Not yet, but I think I'm going to need to talk to him this week.
It's worth talking soon, before the situation gets worse.
006: Do you know if the housing wi-fi is good?
It depends on the time. At night it gets a bit slow, but in the morning it's great.
I need to watch some video lessons, so I'll take advantage of the morning.
Good idea. If the signal drops, the front desk staff can help restart the router.
Oh, good to know. Thanks for the tip!
No problem! Just call if you need anything.
007: Have you joined any activity that the housing organized?
I joined the soccer tournament last month. It was a lot of fun.
I didn't know there was a tournament. How did you find out?
They announce it on the housing WhatsApp group. Aren't you in the group?
Not yet. Can you add me?
Of course! I'll add you today.
008: Are you missing the food from home?
I really miss my mom's cooking, especially on Sundays.
I miss it too. Homemade food is something else, right?
It really is. But here we're learning to manage on our own in the kitchen.
That's true. Have you tried making any recipes from home?
I tried making my grandma's cornmeal cake, but it didn't turn out the same.
009: Do you know if there's a curfew for getting back to the housing?
There's no curfew, but the main gate is locked at midnight.
And what do you do if someone arrives after midnight?
There's a side entrance that stays open, but you need to use your ID card.
Oh, I see. Good thing there's that option.
Yeah, but it's best to avoid it, because the security guard writes down who comes in late.
010: Have you thought about living somewhere else next semester?
I have, but the housing is much cheaper and it's close to the university.
That's true, the location is great. And the price helps too.
Besides that, here you get to meet a lot of people and make friends.
That's a very positive point, for sure.
Yeah, for now I plan to stay here.
